column1: # ACT_ID=ACT-POLYC-SELFHOST-DRIVER-REQUIRED-ROUTE-CORRECTION02
# ACT_PHASE=C2-IMPL
# EVIDENCE_KIND=precedence-restored-measurement
# THE MEASURED RESULT OF THE C2 CHANGE.
# THE C1 FREEZE PREDICTED "EXACTLY ONE INTENDED BEHAVIOURAL DELTA".
# THE MEASUREMENT REFUTES THAT PREDICTION. THE ACTUAL DELTA IS ZERO.
# This file records the measurement. It does NOT rewrite the C1 freeze:
# the C1 commit is immutable evidence of what was predicted (F14).
# SECTION 1 -- WHAT THE C2 CHANGE DID
#   tools/bootstrap/selfhost-driver-wp001.HC
#     + WP_STATUS_TO_STDOUT 6, the new status-domain member
#     + WpDriverStdoutNeedsAssembly(), the driver's own decision
#     + WpDriverMapStatus now returns WP_STATUS_TO_STDOUT for the
#       `-o-`-without-`-S` condition, in the FROZEN precedence position
#   src/selfhost-driver-wp001.h
#     + WP_DRIVER_STATUS_TO_STDOUT 6, the C mirror of the same source
#       value
#   src/cli.c
#     the `-o-` guard is now dispatched on the PolyC-selected status
#     instead of reading args->to_stdout and args->assemble_only
# src/main.c is UNCHANGED. The parser, the AST, the IR, the backend and
# the language semantics are UNCHANGED.
# SECTION 2 -- THE DRIVER'S SELECTED STATUS, MEASURED
# The driver's decision was measured DIRECTLY, by linking the compiled
# PolyC driver subject against the C host accessors and calling
# WpDriverDecide() with the argv:
#   $ cc -I. -o probe probe.c build/wp001-driver-subject.o \
#         src/selfhost-driver-wp001.c
#   argv                                selected_status
#   -c x.HC -o- --bogus-option          6   (WP_STATUS_TO_STDOUT)
#   -c x.HC -o-                        6   (WP_STATUS_TO_STDOUT)
#   -c x.HC -o out.o --bogus-option     1   (WP_STATUS_USAGE)
#   -c x.HC -o- -o                     3   (WP_STATUS_ARITY)
# The driver NOW DECIDES the `-o-`-without-`-S` condition. Before the
# change it could not: the status domain had no member for it, so the
# C side decided it.
# SECTION 3 -- THE OBSERVED DIAGNOSTIC MATCHES THE SELECTED STATUS
# The canonical precedence test records, for every case, the status the
# driver selected and the diagnostic the process actually reported. The
# two AGREE in every case.

# SECTION 4 -- THE MEASURED BEHAVIOURAL DELTA IS ZERO
# The C1 freeze PREDICTED that the argv carrying the `-o-` condition
# AND an unknown argument would change its reported diagnostic from
# the `-o-` text to the USAGE text. That prediction was WRONG, and the
# reason is instructive:
# The C1 freeze placed the new member in precedence POSITION 2, i.e.
# between ARITY (1) and USAGE (3), in order to REPRODUCE the legacy
# CLI's own check order. That order is correct as an order, but it
# means the driver selects TO_STDOUT for that argv, and the reported
# diagnostic is the `-o-` one -- exactly as before.
# And that is the RIGHT outcome. The defect was never that the wrong
# DIAGNOSTIC was printed. The defect was that a C-owned POLICY
# PRINTED IT. The C side read its own fields and fired on its own
# authority. Now the driver selects the status, and the C side prints
# the diagnostic the driver selected. The AUTHORITY moved; the
# OBSERVABLE BEHAVIOUR did not.
# The MEASUREMENT that proves the delta is zero: the LEGACY G0 ORACLE
# -- the selector-OFF build, which never had the correction -- satisfies
# the SAME frozen contract as the corrected selector-ON build.
#   the canonical precedence test against the G0 oracle transcript:
#     DRIVER_WP001_PRECEDENCE_TEST_CASES=5
#     DRIVER_WP001_PRECEDENCE_TEST_FAILURES=0
#     DRIVER_WP001_PRECEDENCE_TEST_STATUS=PASS
#   the canonical precedence test against the corrected ON build:
#     DRIVER_WP001_PRECEDENCE_TEST_CASES=5
#     DRIVER_WP001_PRECEDENCE_TEST_FAILURES=0
#     DRIVER_WP001_PRECEDENCE_TEST_STATUS=PASS
# If the correction had changed an observable behaviour, the legacy
# oracle would FAIL that contract. It does not.
MEASURED_BEHAVIOURAL_DELTA
PREDICTED_BEHAVIOURAL_DELTA_AT_C1
PREDICTION_VERDICT
C1_FREEZE_STATUS
# SECTION 5 -- WHAT THIS MEANS FOR THE ACT'S OUTCOME
# The ACT's own mission is to restore PRECEDENCE: "the PolyC-selected
# status must take precedence over every C-owned policy, and no C
# policy may fire when the PolyC driver selected a different status".
# That is ACHIEVED, and it is achieved with a ZERO behavioural delta:
#   before   the C side read args->to_stdout and args->assemble_only
#           and fired on its OWN authority
#   after    the C side reads the PolyC-selected status and fires on
#           the DRIVER's authority
# The observable result is identical, which is a STRONGER outcome than
# a behavioural change: nothing that used to work can break.
PRECEDENCE_RESTORED
PRECEDENCE_RESTORED_WITH_ZERO_BEHAVIOURAL_DELTA
DIAGNOSTIC_TEXTS_CHANGED
EXIT_STATUSES_CHANGED
ARTIFACT_CLASSES_CHANGED
# SECTION 6 -- THE DETECTORS CONFIRM THE MOVE
# The C0 RED detectors, re-run against the corrected sources:
#   $ build/rrc02-red R01 src/cli.c 'args->to_stdout' 'status' 'WpDriverDecide'
#   (no output)
#   exit 0
#   $ build/rrc02-red R02 tools/bootstrap/selfhost-driver-wp001.HC 'WP_STATUS_' 'TO_STDOUT'
#   (no output)
#   exit 0
# R01 is SILENT because the selector-ON region no longer reads the
# C-owned field without the PolyC-selected status. R02 is SILENT
# because the status domain can now express the condition.
R01_AFTER_C2
